title: [YSQL] Fix flaky test TestPgRegressYbBitmapScans#testPgRegressYbBitmapScans
body:
Jira Link: [DB-15844](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-15844)
### Description

The test fails with the following diff

```
diff -U3 ${TEST_TMPDIR}/pgregress_output/yb_bitmap_scans_schedule/expected/yb.orig.bitmap_scans_colo.out ${TEST_TMPDIR}/pgregress_output/yb_bitmap_scans_schedule/results/yb.orig.bitmap_scans_colo.out
--- ${TEST_TMPDIR}/pgregress_output/yb_bitmap_scans_schedule/expected/yb.orig.bitmap_scans_colo.out	2025-03-20 01:26:18.375943945 +0000
+++ ${TEST_TMPDIR}/pgregress_output/yb_bitmap_scans_schedule/results/yb.orig.bitmap_scans_colo.out	2025-03-20 01:26:18.318944041 +0000
@@ -1487,13 +1487,12 @@
 SELECT s.bigint_col, t.int4_col FROM recheck_test s JOIN recheck_test t ON s.bigint_col = t.int4_col;
                                      QUERY PLAN                                     
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- Nested Loop (actual rows=7 loops=1)
+ Nested Loop (actual rows=16 loops=1)
    ->  Seq Scan on recheck_test s (actual rows=9 loops=1)
-   ->  YB Bitmap Table Scan on recheck_test t (actual rows=1 loops=9)
-         Storage Recheck Cond: (int4_col = s.bigint_col)
+   ->  YB Bitmap Table Scan on recheck_test t (actual rows=2 loops=9)
          ->  Bitmap Index Scan on recheck_test_int4_col_idx (actual rows=2 loops=9)
                Index Cond: (int4_col = s.bigint_col)
-(6 rows)
+(5 rows)
 
 --
 -- test where casting may cause us to require recheck (with expression pushdown disabled)
@@ -1559,14 +1558,12 @@
 SELECT s.bigint_col, t.int4_col FROM recheck_test s JOIN recheck_test t ON s.bigint_col = t.int4_col;
                                      QUERY PLAN                                     
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- Nested Loop (actual rows=7 loops=1)
+ Nested Loop (actual rows=16 loops=1)
    ->  Seq Scan on recheck_test s (actual rows=9 loops=1)
-   ->  YB Bitmap Table Scan on recheck_test t (actual rows=1 loops=9)
-         Recheck Cond: (int4_col = s.bigint_col)
-         Rows Removed by Index Recheck: 1
+   ->  YB Bitmap Table Scan on recheck_test t (actual rows=2 loops=9)
          ->  Bitmap Index Scan on recheck_test_int4_col_idx (actual rows=2 loops=9)
                Index Cond: (int4_col = s.bigint_col)
-(7 rows)
+(5 rows)
 
 RESET yb_enable_expression_pushdown;
 --
```

across build types.

kind/bug
